title: axiom community setup
description: setups/<id>/setup.json: what the gallery shows about a setup. Its config is config.json beside it.

author.description: Your GitHub handle, without the @. Only you (or a maintainer) can update the setup.

description.description: One line: what it looks like, or what it's for.

about.description: Optional, Markdown: the idea behind it, its inspiration, tips for using it.

tags.description: From a fixed list, so the gallery's filters stay useful. Ask in an issue for a new one.

tested.description: The compositors you ran it on.

fonts.description: Font families it uses, the config's Appearance.font.family included. Users without one see a fallback.

wallpaper.description: Only with a wallpaper file. Users choose whether to use it.

license.description: SPDX id (CC0-1.0, CC-BY-4.0, …), or "own" for your own work shared under this repo's license.

source.description: Where it comes from (https URL), or "own".

credit.description: Optional: the artist, as they want to be credited.
